reason: Alert 1 alert-FP: resolved sink value is user input with '-->' removed, wrapped in <!-- ... --> comment delimiters. Browsers parse HTML comments before executing scripts, so content inside comments never executes. The XSS sink is HTML comment output, not direct HTML/script execution. Comment wrapper prevents XSS exploitation.

evidence.note: User param flows through replace('-->') then into HTML comment wrapper: response.getWriter().println("<!-- " + safe + " -->"). Script tags inside comments are ignored by browsers.
